Frontend.reason: Tracker keeps learning content local by default and lets a signed-in learner choose cloud storage for a new or edited plan, including each AI-confirmed plan, practice record, timer record, or word record. The plan editor and AI confirmation show the plan allowance before a paired transfer, refresh global storage availability and remaining allowance during normal use, and keep local content intact on cloud failures. The IELTS writing editor now shows an explicit English-word count; contractions, hyphenated compounds, dates, amounts and Unicode whitespace use the same rule as the AI request, while Chinese text is not counted as English words.

Backend.reason: A paired Formal release adds optional per-kind Tracker cloud quotas, a caller-only version-and-cursor status refresh RPC, a backward-compatible batch marker, and atomic upload/detach endpoints for a plan together with its executions. Existing cloud data is kept and grandfathered; data the learner removes and later uploads again uses the current allowance. The shared Edge writing contract now validates the same English-word grammar as the editor, so an AI payload cannot accept a stale or provider-supplied word count. For the default Agnes writing route only, the gateway also uses a 24-second provider window plus one bounded schema-repair retry for an otherwise valid response; transport, refusal and provider-server errors are not retried. The shared word-record validator and permanent-account-deletion endpoint remain required counterparts, with all ownership and server-secret boundaries preserved.

Admin.reason: Existing Lexi Control global policy and per-user override settings already increment the versions consumed by the client refresh. The word-count correction adds no administrator setting, report field, search field or learner-content exposure; the control site was reviewed and needs no code change.

Deployment.reason: Not deployed. First apply and verify the compatible Formal database migrations and Edge contract; then deploy the matching Tracker client and Lexi Control build; finally enable optional content-cloud storage in Lexi Control. The vocabulary product and its already deployed cloud-wordbook behavior are not changed by this Tracker release.

Verification.reason: Tracker verify:release passed: release impact, typecheck, lint, 67 test files / 435 tests and production bundle checks. Formal verify:release also passed, including the conditional status migration, Edge AI gateway function scenarios and SQL contracts; coordinated writing-contract parity passed with TRACKER_REPO_ROOT. Production still needs authenticated RPC, normal second-device, writing submission and cross-account smoke tests after the compatible migration and matching Pages builds are deployed.
